hook: Mixed, rough (雑) cloth (巾): an everyday cloth for wiping floors.
Send (送) someone off at a parting (別): a farewell.
Send (送) + fee (料): the fee you pay to send something, postage.
属 means belong to a group: 属する is to belong to or be part of something.
Measure (測) and fix (定) the number: a measurement.
Plain (率) and straight (直): saying things directly, frank.
Big (大) + して, used with a negative: "not a big amount", so not very much.
Big (大) and small (小): together they mean size.
Body (体) + operate, work (操): working your body, physical exercise.
A big (大) part (分): considerably, a lot.
Standing (立) facing (対) each other: two sides in opposition.
Stand (立ち) + stop (止まる): you stop walking and stand still.
Collected (溜) breath (息): the breath you let out all at once, a sigh.
A group (団) of homes on one piece of land (地): a housing complex.
Cut off (断) doubt and fix (定) it: to decide firmly, a conclusion.
Your long, excellent (長) point (所): a strong point. Opposite: 短所, short point.
Directly (直) after (後): immediately following.
散 means scatter: 散らかす is to scatter things around and make a mess.
Pass through (通) and be used (用): accepted and usable everywhere.
繋 means tie or link: 繋がり is a link between things or people.
潰 means crush: 潰す is to smash flat, or to kill time (時間を潰す).
詰 means pack in tight: when too much is packed in, it gets blocked.
Stop (停) + stop (止): a double stop, a full stoppage.
Out (出) and in (入り): coming and going.
Put (入れ) your hands (手) into it: care and maintenance.
The neck (首) of the hand (手): your wrist.
Hand (手) steps that continue (続き) one after another: a procedure.
照 means shine light: 照らす is to shine light on something.
Spread out (展) and open (開): to unfold or develop.
See through (透) and clear, bright (明): transparent.
Specially (特) fixed (定): a specific, particular one.
Special (特) selling (売): a special sale.
The floor (床) space (間): a raised alcove in a Japanese room.
Take (取り) and bring out (出す): to take something out.
何 (what) + とも: "I can't say what it is", so really, extremely.
Day (日) use (用) goods (品): things you use every day.
鈍 has metal (金): a dull, blunt blade, and also a slow, dull mind.
Not remaining (残らず): nothing is left over, so all of it, without exception.
Ride (乗り) over, past (越し) your stop: riding past your station.
Same 鈍 (dull) as にぶい, but のろい means slow moving; のろのろ is "slowly".
Ash (灰) color (色): grey.
The feeling (気) of wanting to throw up (吐き): nausea.
挟 has a hand (扌): your hand holds something between two things.
At the start (始め): to begin with, first of all.
In the middle (中) of talking (話): the phone line is busy.
Broken (破) piece (片): a fragment.
Needle (針) metal (金): thin metal like a needle, wire.
Reflect (映) back (反): an image reflected back, or something that shows an influence.
Pull (引き) out (出す): pull out a drawer, or take money out of the bank.
Judge (評) and discuss (論): a critique or review.
広い (wide) + さ (how much): how wide it is, the extent.
Widely (普) reach (及): something spreads to everyone.
更 (further, late at night, as in 夜更け): the night goes further on, it gets late.
Blowing (吹) snow (雪): a snowstorm.
Swing (振り) to face (向く) another way: to turn around.
Divide (分) and undo (解): take apart, break down.
The body, form (体) of the writing (文): writing style.
Flat, calm (平) feeling (気): cool and calm, "I'm fine".
Separate (別), written twice (々 repeats it): each one separately.
Direction (方) + angle, corner (角): which way, a direction.
Area (方, as in 地方) + words (言): the way people talk in one area, a dialect.
Direction (方) needle (針): like a compass needle, a policy shows the way.
Wrap (包) + band, belt (帯): a band you wrap around a wound.
解 means undo: ほどく is to undo a knot or untie.
Street (街) corner (角): a street corner.
The very (真っ) front, tip (先): the very first.
Full (満) points (点): a perfect score.
Look (見) up (上げる): to look up at, or look up to someone.
Watch (見) as you send (送る) them off: to see someone off.
見掛ける means to catch sight of: 見掛け is what you see at first, the outward look.
Your body's (身) share, place (分): your position or status in society.
Not yet (未) full (満): less than; 18歳未満 means under 18.
Point (指す) your eyes (目) at it: to aim for a goal.
目 (eye, mark) + 安 (easy): an easy mark to check against, a rough guide.
Excused from (免) tax (税): tax free.
A thing (物) you hold up (差し) against something to measure it: a ruler.
Play (遊) garden (園) land (地): an amusement park.
Mail (郵) + send (送): to send by post.
Like letting the lamp oil (油) run out, cut off (断): a careless moment.
翌 means the next one: 翌日 is the next day, 翌年 the next year.
Wild, messy (乱) + violent (暴): rough and violent behaviour.
Both (両) sides (側): both sides.
Facing (臨) the time (時), just for now: temporary, special.
Your turn (番) to watch the house while people are away (留守): house sitting.
割 (ratio, compared): 割と means "compared to what you expect", fairly, quite.
泊 has water (氵): a boat stops at shore for the night; 二泊 is two nights.
再 means again: 再開 is to open again.
低 means low: 低温 is low temperature, 低価格 is low price.
位 means rank, a person (亻) standing (立) in their place: 一位 is first place.
通り is the road you pass along (通る): a street, or "along the lines of", as said.
隙 is a small gap: a gap in your guard, a chance for someone else.
我 means I, we, self: 我が国 is our country.
史 means history: 日本史 is Japanese history.
辛い (painful) after a verb: painful to do, hard to do; 読みづらい is hard to read.
切れ means cut off, run out: 時間切れ is time cut off, out of time.
防 means protect against: 防水 is waterproof, 防犯 is crime prevention.
向け comes from 向く (to face): made facing a group; 子供向け is for children.
羽 means feather, wing: so you count birds (and rabbits, by tradition) with 羽.
巻 means roll: old books were scrolls you rolled, so 巻 counts volumes.
省 is a government ministry: 外務省 is the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.
条 means a line, an article: 第九条 is Article 9 of a law.
畳 is a tatami mat: 六畳 is a room the size of six mats.
各 means each: 各国 is each country.
省 also means cut down, save: 省エネ is saving energy.
非 means not, wrong: 非常識 is lacking common sense.
未 means not yet: 未完成 is not yet finished.
遣う means to use: 言葉遣い is the way you use words, 無駄遣い is wasting money.
Two jade pieces (王王) over 今 (giving the sound きん): a fine string instrument, a zither.
総 means all, whole: 総数 is the total number.
爪 is a picture of a hand reaching down with claws: your nails.
Metal (金) + 同 (sound どう): copper; 銅メダル is the bronze medal.
殿 means palace, lord: writing 殿 after a name honours them, like Mr.
丼 looks like a well (井) with food dropped in: a bowl of rice with food on top.
蓋 has grass (艹) on top: something that covers the top, a lid.
Wood (木) + 冘: old Japanese pillows were wooden blocks for your head.
Mountain (山) + 甲 (shell, armour): hard land that sticks out into the sea, a cape.
紫 has thread (糸): thread dyed purple, an old royal colour.
帳 has cloth (巾): sheets bound into a book; 手帳 is a notebook, 通帳 a bankbook.
等 means rank, grade: 一等 is first class, first prize.
等 means "and others": 彼等 (かれら) is he and the others, they.
続く means continue: 雨が続く, the rain goes on.
難 means difficult: 信じ難い is hard to believe.
刊 means publish: 朝刊 is the morning paper, 週刊 is weekly.
領 means rule over land: 日本領 is Japanese territory.
副 means second, sub: 副社長 is the vice president of a company.
系 has thread (糸): a line of connected things, a system or group; 理系 is science.
沿 has water (氵): following along a river; 川沿い is along the river.
Number (番) + 目 (the ~th): 三番目 is the third one.
御 makes words polite: 御中 (おんちゅう) is written after a company name on letters.
式 means style, method: 日本式 is Japanese style.
圏 is inside a box (囗): a closed area; 首都圏 is the capital area.
Hour (時間) + 目 (the ~th): 二時間目 is second period at school.
過ぎる means go past: go past the limit, too much; 食べ過ぎる is eat too much.
艘 has boat (舟): counts boats; 一艘 is one boat.
庁 has a roof (广): a government office; 気象庁 is the weather agency.
兆 means sign, omen, and also trillion: 一兆円 is one trillion yen.
丁 counts town blocks + 目 (the ~th): 三丁目 is the 3rd block in an address.
滴 has water (氵): a drop of water; 一滴 is one drop.
遍 means all over, times: 一遍 is once, 何遍も is many times.
扇 is a fan, a door (戸) with feathers (羽): to fan yourself.
呆 looks like a mouth (口) on a tree (木), mouth open in shock: to be appalled.
Until (まで) you are fed up (飽く): to the very end, stubbornly.
明 (bright): when it gets light, the next day comes; 明くる日 is the next day.
憧 has heart (忄): your heart longs for something, to admire.
Morning (朝) sleep (寝) boy (坊): a boy who sleeps late, oversleeping.
Thick (厚) skinned: so bold you feel no shame, cheeky.
Press (圧) and shrink (縮): compress.
The name (名) it is sent to (宛): the address on a letter.
It hits (当て) and fits in (はまる): to apply, to fit a category.
Hit (当て) and fit it in (はめる): to apply a rule to something.
暴 means violent: 暴れる is to act wildly, to rage.
Rain (雨) + door (戸): the door you shut against the rain.
甘い (sweet) + やかす: being too sweet with a child, spoiling them.
余 means extra: 余る is to be left over.
Knitted (編み) things (物): knitting.
編 has thread (糸): you knit threads together.
危 means danger (as in 危ない): 危うい is dangerous, at risk.
荒 has grass (艹): wild, overgrown land, so rough and wild.
粗 has rice (米): rice not finely ground, so coarse, rough.
Rough (粗) lines (筋): the rough outline of a story, a synopsis.
改 means change, reform: 改める is to change for the better, revise.
Hard (難) to have (有): something rare, so you are thankful (ありがとう).
荒 means wild: 荒れる is when weather or a place becomes rough or wild.
慌 has heart (忄): a panicked heart, so busy and hurried.
Say (言い) and attach (付ける) a task: to tell someone to do it, to order.
Meaning (意) + right, reason (義): the meaning or value of something.
Alive (生き) + alive (生き): full of life, lively.
幾 means how many, some: 幾つ is how many, 幾日 is several days.
Some (幾) part (分): somewhat, a little.
Living (生け) flowers (花): the art of flower arranging.
From (以) then on, after (後): from now on.
勇 means brave (勇気 is courage): brave and bold.
One (一) response (応): one quick go for now, tentatively, just in case.
One (一) step (段) up: even more, by far.
One (一) before last (昨) year (年): the year before last.
旦 is the sun (日) over the horizon (一), dawn: 一旦 means once, for a moment.
Go (行って) and come back (いらっしゃい): said to someone leaving, have a good day.
Move (移) and shift (転): moving to a new place.
緯 (the threads across a loom) + degree (度): lines across the globe, latitude.
Stretch out (張る) your power (威): to act proud, to swagger.
嫌 (dislike) + がる (show signs of): to show you dislike something.
煎 has fire (灬) under it: to roast beans or seeds dry over fire.
炒 has fire (火): to roast or dry fry; 炒飯 (チャーハン) is fried rice.
A thing (物) you put (入れ) things in: a container.
Pulling (引) power (力): gravity.
Planted (植) trees (木): garden trees or potted plants.
飢 has food (食): having no food, to starve.
浮 has water (氵): to float on water, or an idea floats up in your mind.
浮 (float): 浮かべる is to make something float, or let a smile show on your face.
浮 has water (氵): to float on water.
承 means receive, agree: a humble way to say you hear or accept a request.
Receive (受) and take (取): a receipt.
Receive (受け) and hold (持つ): to take charge of a class or job.
Thinly (薄) dark (暗い): a little dark, dim.
薄い (thin, weak) + める: to make thinner, to water down.
Hit (打ち) and match (合わせ) ideas: a meeting to plan things.
Hit (打ち) and erase (消す): to deny something.
敬 means respect (敬語 is polite speech): to respect someone.
Turn (返す) to the back side (裏): turn over or inside out.
占 is a mouth (口) under a divining rod (卜): to tell fortunes.
